objective: Configure PodDisruptionBudget for critical search-indexing cluster.

context.content: Deployment replicas: 5; node upgrades drain 1 node at a time.
Image: elasticsearch:8.11.2 with custom synonyms plugin.

mechanism_options.pool_connection_leak: Connections acquired by a handler are not released.
mechanism_options.cache_expiry_stampede: Synchronized cache expiration without jitter causes a stampede.
mechanism_options.disable_feature_flag: Disable the dynamic feature flag rather than roll back the binary.
mechanism_options.unclosed_client_session: Unclosed client sessions retained by an event listener.
mechanism_options.blocked_external_http_no_timeout: Consumer thread blocked on an external HTTP call without timeout.
mechanism_options.circuit_breaker_timeout: Choose a latency trip timeout within the downstream latency budget.
mechanism_options.pmtud_blackhole: Path MTU discovery blackhole drops certificate fragments.
mechanism_options.catastrophic_regex_backtracking: Nested regex repetition causes catastrophic backtracking.
mechanism_options.open_deleted_file: An unlinked log still consumes space because a process holds it open.
mechanism_options.online_logical_replication: Online logical replication/CDC with a short cutover.
mechanism_options.cors_wildcard_credentials: Credentialed browser request cannot use wildcard allowed origin.
mechanism_options.binary_float_rounding: Binary floating-point currency arithmetic causes rounding differences.
mechanism_options.configure_pdb: Configure a valid Kubernetes PodDisruptionBudget preserving required replicas.
mechanism_options.musl_conntrack_dns: Musl parallel A/AAAA queries reuse a source port and encounter conntrack drops.
mechanism_options.capacity_exhaustion: Pool size alone is too small for ordinary demand.
mechanism_options.gc_pressure: Garbage collection pause causes the incident.
mechanism_options.deployment_binary_regression: Roll back a changed application binary.
mechanism_options.disk_named_files: Ordinary named files are filling the filesystem.
mechanism_options.kafka_insufficient_partitions: Too few Kafka partitions for throughput.

response_contract: Use parameters.min_available OR parameters.max_unavailable for a valid PDB manifest; do not specify both.
